projects.title: B1NBAGS
projects.subtitle: Personal clothing brand · Hong Kong
projects.shortDescription: A personal clothing brand started in Hong Kong in 2023.
projects.description: B1NBAGS is a brand I started in 2023 in Hong Kong, paused in 2024 to focus on university, and restarted in 2025. The video work focuses on selling the creative lifestyle rather than the product — high-quality reels shot on a cinema-grade camera, colour-graded with film emulations to build a consistent vintage, textured feel.

projects.title: Halatia
projects.subtitle: Brand identity · Eau de parfum · Paris
projects.shortDescription: Brand identity and art direction for Halatia Paris, a Parisian eau de parfum.
projects.description: Brand identity and art direction for Halatia Paris — a Parisian eau de parfum. The brand takes its name from halation, the photographic phenomenon of light spreading beyond its proper boundaries, used as a metaphor for a fragrance that leaves a radiant, invisible impression. The identity is built around an orange signature colour representing optimism, confidence, warmth and boundless energy, paired with a vintage film aesthetic drawn from Paris and classic photography. Designed for a new generation that defies labels.
